Role: Fractional COO
Industry: Information Services
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Asana is the best project management software out there. I love that it focuses on perfecting functionality for a cohesive user experience. Task management across teams and projects make day to day work more manageable.
Cons: [sentence mentioning the target product removed] Team adoption is a real challenge with Asana and really solid onboarding is required to get the most out of the product.

Role: Senior Marketing Manager
Industry: E-Learning
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Wir im Marketing können super unsere Projekte damit planen und haben jederzeit alles im Blick und müssen nicht an alles denken.
Cons: Hier kann ich eigentlich nichts finden. ...
Comments: Ich organisiere ein Team von 5 Leuten damit. Wir planen alle Projekte, erstellen Tickets und Subtickets und legen Fristen und Verantwortlichkeiten fest. So lässt sich immer gut sehen, was schon erledigt wurde und was bald ansteht.
Reasons for switching: Die Übersichtlichkeit in Jira war eine Katastrophe.
Switched from: Jira

Role: Owner and Designer
Industry: Design
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Asana is a great project management tool. It provides a central location to organize and assign tasks, track progress visually, and easily collaborate with your team.
Cons: It can be overwhelming at first with it's robust capabilities.
Comments: Asana is a great user-friendly interface that allows for easy task management and communication within projects.

Role: Senior Project manager
Industry: Oil & Energy
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It is somewhat limiting that a task can only be assigned to a single individual. While others can be added as “collaborators” by tagging their @name in the comments, I noticed this only after realizing that I wanted both people to review a document without creating separate tasks for each of them.
Cons: I really like the color scheme, the intuitive user interface, and the smooth performance. The mobile apps for individual use are excellent, and the platform is very beginner-friendly. That’s why I prefer it. I will definitely recommend this software to my agent. I’ve also already encouraged my friends and family to try Asana, and many of them are very satisfied, providing me with positive feedback. Additionally, the connectivity is seamless and reliable.
Comments: It’s very convenient to create tasks that are part of a project as well as [truncated]

Role: Owner and Freelancer
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I love how easy Asana is to use and how you're able to put everything into different boards/projects.
Cons: I haven't found anything that I dislike about Asana.
Comments: It's perfect for my workflow and organizing my tasks for my website.
Reasons for switching: Asana is more user-friendly than Monday was for me.
Switched from: monday.com AI Work Platform

Role: Branch Manager
Industry: Facilities Services
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 2
Pros: There is a lot of power within the program and it give you a lot of flexibility when you are assigning tasks to coworkers and creating projects to work on.
Cons: If you have a small team, it isn't that valuable as this seems more designed for larger teams. Also, there is a sharp learning curve since there are so many features offered.
Comments: I found this program a bit too overwhelming and had too much for me and what I needed in my organization. If I had more teams working underneath me, it would be worth it.

Role: Trainer
Industry: Banking
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Love how tasks get organized based on level tasks such as team, and self.
Cons: There’s really nothing I don’t like about Asana
Reasons for choosing: Team selected the best product collaborately.
Reasons for switching: Task provided a better option to organizing tasks
Switched from: Microsoft Outlook
Alternatives considered: Microsoft SharePoint|Zoho Sprints|monday.com AI Work Platform|Hive

Role: Client Services Manager
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Gives a great deal of transparency for remote workers on a number of projects that we collectively work on. You are able to assign and complete tasks openly with your other team members.
Cons: Can be slightly cluttered and could be streamlined.
Comments: Happy using it and feel it helps our team work.

Role: Marketing Advisor
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: It's a complete tool for project managements for teams of any size.
Cons: Learning how to use it efficiently and make the best of all its features is not easy.
Comments: I find Asana a very complete tool for Project Management, I used it for teams that work all remotely, even with different time zones, and even though it was small teams, so I couldn't use it to the full extent I really see how it can improve productivity and even change the way teams work.

Role: Project Manager
Industry: Writing and Editing
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: What I like most is the intuitive and clean interface. Even though it has a lot of features, it doesn't feel cluttered. Being able to switch between List, Board, and Timeline views easily is a game-changer because I can see my work exactly how I need to depending on the day.
Cons: While it’s very powerful, there is a bit of a learning curve at the beginning. It takes some time to figure out the best way to set up projects and workflows so things don't get messy, but other than that, all good.
Comments: My overall experience with Asana has been great. It has completely transformed the way my team organizes projects and handles deadlines. While it took us a little bit of time to get everyone comfortable with the interface and manage the notification settings, the clarity it provides is worth it. It’s a very visual, rewarding way to manage [truncated]

Role: Marketing Coordinator
Industry: Education Management
Company size: 5,001-10,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Kanban boards have helped me organize mail campaigns, content for social networks, and digital advertising in general. I divide projects into progression lists so I can organize our resources according to what I need: time, money and staff. The integration with other external software is just wonderful: Slack for real-time communications and notifications, Google Drive for storage, Mailchimp for automatic campaigns, etc. Also, customizable templates save us a lot of time. And Butler simplifies repetitive tasks that I don't want to do. It's like a virtual secretary.
Cons: I know Trello is designed to be extremely simple, but I would like to be able to employ statistics to evaluate ROI.
Comments: In marketing, we require many types of employees to move a project forwards. Trello helps me communicate and manage tasks that need [truncated]

Role: Sr. Software Consultant and project manager
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It is very fast and ui/ux is very easy to understand
Cons: As of now, I haven't faced any drawbacks or cons. Yes, I didn't find a calendar for schedule tasks... not sure, if I missed anything

Role: manager
Industry: Executive Office
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Trello has a good layout, works well for task management. Easy set up and organization of workflow management.
Cons: Less user friendly than other programs. Layout is clean but could be improved in functionality. It was a great initial program when going to an online workflow organization format but not the best fit for my specific needs.
Comments: Overall it was a good experience. While it wasn't the best fit for me, it is a great option when looking at workflow management tools.

Role: Digital Manager
Industry: Machinery
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Trello is great for project management and creating breakout spaces to drill down into multiple different projects; it’s been a huge help in making progress more transparent.
Cons: Some useful features are part of the premium option which could be worth including in the free plan.
Comments: Very positive, it’s helped convey project progress and deliverables with key stakeholders.

Role: Founder
Industry: Management Consulting
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The simplicity of the layouts and dashboard
Cons: The lack of more functionality and more features
Comments: I had no complaints with any of the projects I used trello for

Role: Graphic Officer
Industry: Design
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Quick and easy to organise tasks using the card system
Cons: not really suitable for hosting files for a design job. Each card works best as a ticket for the job
Comments: Good worked well organising work accross teams

Role: Chef de projet digital
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 5,001-10,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: La simplicité, Trello permet facilement d’organiser et de suivre les étapes d’avancement d’un projet.
Cons: Il y a une longue liste de plugins à installer qui plus ou moins complexe. Le plus intéressants sont payants.
Reasons for choosing: Il est plus complet. Il a des fontionalités de planification par dates plus intéressantes.
Alternatives considered: monday.com AI Work Platform

Role: Brand Designer
Industry: Design
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: If you love organising your projects from a visual place this software is my favourite to use. I really that I can lay it out in an editorial fashion and include instructions and ideas in the cards. Trello also gives you some prompts that work for the project you're working on at the time. I've used it for designing websites and magazine layouts to organizing a course structure.
Cons: For tasks it seems to really hit the mark, but you cannot create roadmaps. It also doesn't offer analytics or any reporting. There's a lot of paid add-ons which can extend your capabilities to level up project management options but they will add up.
Comments: It's an intuitive project management tool for small teams that want a simply no frills way to track tasks. People who haven't great technical skills will find it easy to navigate.

Role: CEO
Industry: Internet
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Ótima opção pra organizar tarefas, compromisso, lembretes e etc.
Cons: Aplicativo meio complicado de mecher, no geral
Comments: Ótima experiência pela praticidade do dia a dia! E possibilidade de boa logística de tempo.

Role: Technical lead
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I used it to organize a marketing campaign by creating columns for each stage and easily moving tasks between them, keeping everything on track.
Cons: Its limited offline use. When I had no internet, I couldn't update or view my boards, which was frustrating.
